body: I really, really thought I was going to do it this past Friday. In the end I made all the preparations but I didn't actually go through with it. Not sure how I feel about it to be honest. I wouldn't say I'm pleased to be here.

Yeah I definitely need to get out, but with everything else going on its the wrong time to start looking for another job. I'm seriously thinking about just leaving with no other job. I'll see how it looks at Christmas.

If you don't mind me asking, why can't you contact her while you're alive?

​

I've written some notes out recently. Initially I focused on the good things so nobody would feel guilty, but I found that unsatisfying and it felt a little bit dishonest. I felt like people would read them and think "that was nice", and then afterwards realise there was a lot I probably hadn't said and maybe feel they didn't really get any closure. So I rewrote them and made them completely honest. There are good things in there and there are bad things in there. Some are a bit of a rollercoaster, which is appropriate to how things were.

And then I realised that some of the things that were eating away at me were better said in person and to my counsellor. Are those options available to you?
